subject: Proposal: FP&A & Billing Ops hires — comp bands and headcount
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Catherine Lee <catherine.lee@recruitly.co>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: FP&A & Billing Ops hires — comp bands and headcount

Hi team,

We need approvals to move forward with two hires for Finance & Billing in Q2: an FP&A Manager (backfill + expansion to lead monthly forecasting cadence) and a Billing Ops Specialist to support RevOps as we integrate the marketplace billing flows. High-level ask:

- FP&A Manager: headcount approval for 1 FTE, manager-level (IC->manager mix), target start late Apr / early May.
- Billing Ops Specialist: headcount approval for 1 FTE to support billing ops & Zuora handoffs, start mid-May.

Attached: comp_band_fpna_2026.pdf (proposed bands), headcount_request_revops_Q2.xlsx (budget impact). I've penciled in the bands that align to our current salary structure; Evelyn — Catherine (recruiter) has one strong candidate for FP&A (Omari Jackson) who is available now and would require an offer within the top of band + $10k sign-on.

Please confirm:
1) Marcus — do we have budget headroom as presented in the sheet?
2) Rishi — can we prioritize these hires this quarter vs. deferring?
3) Evelyn/Catherine — if approved, please prepare an offer packet for Omari and a job posting for Billing Ops.

Goals: close FP&A by end of March if possible; Billing Ops by mid-May.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance (Interim)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: comp_band_fpna_2026.pdf, headcount_request_revops_Q2.xlsx
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Catherine Lee <catherine.lee@recruitly.co>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: FP&A & Billing Ops hires — comp bands and headcount

Thanks Laura — quick read and some recommendations below. I attached an excerpt of the bands for visibility (see comp_band_fpna_2026.pdf).

Summary: candidate pipeline strong for FP&A; slim for Billing Ops unless we open to contractor-to-hire. Candidate notes:
- Omari Jackson (ref Catherine): 7+ years FP&A experience at a Series C SaaS; expects base $155k–160k and $10k sign-on; has manager-level exposure.
- Recommended FP&A band to use: $140k–165k (we should approve top-of-band exceptions for strong candidates).
- Billing Ops band: $85k–105k; if we want faster ramp, consider $95k midpoint and prioritize billing automation experience.

Ask: if Marcus confirms the budget delta, Catherine can present a verbal offer to Omari by Wed and follow with formal offer doc. Proposed offer structure:
- FP&A Manager (Omari): base $160,000, 10% target bonus, $10,000 sign-on (prorated if <6 months tenure requirement), standard equity grant per manager band.
- Billing Ops: hire at $95,000 (midpoint) or open as 6-month contractor at $48/hr to accelerate.

I can spin the offer_Mgr_FPNA_Omari.docx once Marcus signs off on the numbers.

Evelyn Hart
Recruiting Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: comp_band_fpna_2026.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: FP&A & Billing Ops hires — comp bands and headcount

On Mon, Mar 9, 2026 at 09:12 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> We need approvals to move forward with two hires for Finance & Billing in Q2...

Laura, Evelyn — I reviewed the headcount_request_revops_Q2.xlsx and the FY26 hiring plan. Budget notes:
- We have ~$115k of flexible spend in the FP&A/corporate headcount bucket after planned offers for Q2. Approving Omari at $160k + $10k sign-on fits if we reallocate $30k from the contractor budget (we are underspent on contractors in Q1).
- Billing Ops at $95k can be absorbed in RevOps hiring allocation with a small pull from the marketplace integration contingency ($20k).

Recommend approvals with these conditions:
1) FP&A offer: base $160,000, 10% bonus, $10k sign-on (sign-on funded from contractor reallocation).
2) Billing Ops: post as full-time at $95k; if a faster fill is required, hire a 6-month contractor at $48/hr and convert pending performance review.

If Rishi is comfortable, I can mark these as approved in the headcount tracker and move budget lines.

Marcus Lin
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Catherine Lee <catherine.lee@recruitly.co>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: FP&A & Billing Ops hires — comp bands and headcount

Thanks everyone — approved.

Summary of approvals and next steps:
- FP&A Manager (Omari Jackson) — APPROVED at base $160,000 + 10% target bonus + $10,000 sign-on. Evelyn/Catherine: please finalize offer_Mgr_FPNA_Omari.docx and route to me for sign-off on the equity band before extending. Marcus: confirm the contractor reallocation line in the tracker.
- Billing Ops Specialist — APPROVED as FTE at $95,000. If hiring timeline slips, approve a 6-month contractor conversion as fallback.

HR/Recruiting: proceed to extend verbal offer to Omari immediately; draft formal offer and DocuSign link to be circulated. Finance: reflect approvals in the FY26 headcount tracker and update payroll timelines for new hires starting May.

One more ask: please ensure a 90-day performance check for both hires and align hiring manager goals with the finance OKRs.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Finance & Strategy
Redwood Inference
